messages:
Oncall Bot: Pager: elevated 502/timeout rate observed from mex1 egress toward MX transit peers. Alert ID: 2409999900. Auto-escalating to on-call.
Alex M: Acknowledged, joining. Which prefixes impacted?
Mira S: Edge logs show TCP resets + BGP NOTIFICATION on peer mx-transit-01. Prefix buckets: 2001:db8::/32 + 185.60.0.0/20. Flaps every ~25-45s.
Raj P: Confirmed via route-monitor: session_down on AS64500 peer, BGP withdraws correlate with spikes.
Alex M: Immediate mitigation plan: steer mex1 egress to sfo1 primary, gdl1 secondary. Apply gradual shift to avoid cache churn. @Jordan prepare status update and customer notice template.
Jordan L: Drafting status. Quick check: any customer P1s?
Nina C: CS sees increased tickets from MX customers (~8 tenants reporting timeouts). No P1s yet. I'll prep targeted notifications.
Alex M: Executing reroute override (gradual):
```
redwoodctl net reroute --from=mex1 --to=sfo1 --weight=60 --fallback=gdl1 --duration=30m --note="mx-transit flap"
```
Oncall Bot: Reroute command accepted. New flow distribution: sfo1 60%, gdl1 30%, legacy 10%.
Mira S: After partial cutover 5xx dropped from ~34% -> ~7% within 3m. Some clients still hit legacy due to keepalives.
Raj P: Accelerating conntrack expiry to reduce long-lived TCP stickiness:
```
ssh gw-mex1-01 -- sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=45
```
Oncall Bot: conntrack TTL set to 45s on gw-mex1-01.
Alex M: Also bump frontend retry budget mex1 2->4 to reduce visible failures during flap. Deploying now.
Raj P: Deploy complete: frontend.mex1.retry_budget=4.
Jordan L: Status page draft (for review):
"Incident 2409999900 — Partial egress degradation affecting mex1 (Mexico City) starting at 2409999900 UTC. Impact: intermittent 502s/timeouts for a subset of requests routed through a third-party transit provider. Mitigation: traffic is being rerouted to alternate egresses (SFO1, GDL1). Users in Mexico City may observe higher latency while mitigation is active. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner."
Nina C: Customer note draft: "We're seeing intermittent API failures for traffic originating in Mexico City. Our engineers have rerouted traffic to alternate egresses; degradation should improve. No data loss expected. We'll update in 30 minutes or when resolved. Reference: incident 2409999900."
Mira S: Provider NOC (mx-transit) reports "optical module APR error, replace scheduled" ETA 40-50m. Ticket MXT-1051 opened.
EngOps: Preparing automation to shift full egress to gdl1 if 5xx > 10% sustained for 10m. Standby.
Alex M: Good. Jordan, post initial status now and set 15m cadence. @Nina escalate to any VIP customers.
Jordan L: Posted status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2409999900 — "Mitigation in progress; partial recovery observed."
CS Bot: Notified 8 affected tenants in MX region; support follow-ups in progress.
Raj P: Monitoring shows 5xx stable ~3.8% over last 5m. p50 latency +60ms for rerouted flows.
Mira S: Note: watch cache TTLs — reroute will cause some KV cache misses; cost spike possible.
Alex M: Action items: 1) Keep reroute until provider confirms stable BGP for 30m post-repair; 2) Prepare for full detour to gdl1 if regressions; 3) Capture BGP dumps and tcpdumps for postmortem.
Provider NOC: Update: hardware swap in progress at their MX PoP; monitoring shows fewer withdraws.
Jordan L: Handoff: Alex -> Jordan at 2409999975 UTC for continued monitoring and customer comms. Recorded in-thread.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity set S2 (partial degradation). Pager handoff scheduled. Reminder: create post-incident report including timeline, commands executed, and customer notices.
Jordan L: Taking handoff. I'll keep 15m status cadence. Current state: partial recovery, continuing monitoring.
Alex M: Thanks team. If any regression ping this thread. Closing active ops after BGP stable >30m. :thumbsup:
